crops.name: Wheat

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 50 kg + MOP 25 kg + Zinc Sulphate 10 kg per acre
Urea 45 kg or Nano Urea foliar spray
Urea 35 kg + Micronutrient blend
Foliar spray of 00:52:34 (1 kg/acre) for grain plumping

pest_management.remedy: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L upon first yellow stripe sighting.
Spray Neem Oil (10,000 ppm) @ 3 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.5 g/L.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Rotates exceptionally well after Kharif Soyabean or Moong, which fix residual nitrogen in soil.

climate_risk.heatwave_sensitivity: High (terminal heat in Feb/March lowers grain filling)

crops.advisory_tip: If late sowing occurs after Dec 1st, switch to heat-tolerant varieties like PBW 771 or DBW 187.

crops.name: Paddy (Rice)

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 45 kg + MOP 30 kg + Zinc 10 kg per acre
Urea 40 kg per acre
Urea 30 kg + MOP 15 kg for strong stem support

pest_management.remedy: Install pheromone traps (5/acre); apply Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml/L.
Drain excess water, spray Streptocycline 1.5 g + Copper Oxychloride 25 g in 10 L water.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Follow with Rabi pulses (Chana/Lentil) to restore depleted soil structure and break pest cycles.
crops.advisory_tip: Adopt Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) or Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD) to cut water use by 30%.

crops.name: Soyabean

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 50 kg + MOP 20 kg + Sulphur Bentonite 10 kg per acre
Foliar spray of 19:19:19 (1 kg) + Boron (100g) in 100L water
Spray 00:52:34 (1.5 kg/acre) to maximize seed weight and oil content

pest_management.remedy: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 4 g/10 L water or Chlorantraniliprole.
Control whitefly vectors using yellow sticky traps (10/acre) and Acetamiprid.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Fixes 35-40 kg atmospheric nitrogen per acre, reducing next season's wheat/mustard fertilizer cost by 25%.

climate_risk.unseasonal_rain_sensitivity: High during pod maturity and harvesting

crops.advisory_tip: Plant on broad bed furrow (BBF) ridges to avoid waterlogging during heavy rainfall bursts.

crops.name: Mustard

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 35 kg + SSP 50 kg (for vital Sulphur) + MOP 15 kg per acre
Urea 35 kg per acre
Sulphur 80% WDG spray (2 g/L) to enhance oil percentage

pest_management.remedy: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5 ml/L when temperature rises in Jan.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Low water user; leaves soil in fine tilth for summer mungbean or early bajra.

climate_risk.unseasonal_rain_sensitivity: High (aphid surge if cloudy/rainy in Jan)

crops.advisory_tip: Excellent low-water alternative to wheat; gives higher profit margin per drop of water.

crops.name: Tur (Arhar / Pigeon Pea)

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 40 kg + MOP 15 kg + Rhizobium culture seed coating
Foliar spray of 00:52:34 (1.5 kg/acre) + Planofix (0.25 ml/L) to prevent flower drop
Spray 13:00:45 (Potassium Nitrate) @ 10 g/L for plump grain formation

pest_management.remedy: Install 4 bird perches and 5 pheromone traps/acre; spray HaNPV or Chlorantraniliprole @ 0.3 ml/L.
Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg seed; ensure soil drainage.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Deep taproots aerate subsoil down to 2 meters and fix massive amounts of nitrogen for subsequent crops.
crops.advisory_tip: Best crop for climate resilience in drought-prone Marathwada & North Karnataka.

crops.name: Cotton

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 50 kg + MOP 30 kg + Magnesium Sulphate 10 kg per acre
Urea 35 kg per acre + Zinc EDTA spray
Urea 35 kg + MOP 20 kg per acre
Foliar spray of 13:00:45 (10 g/L) to prevent boll reddening

pest_management.remedy: Pheromone traps (8/acre). Spray Profenofos 50% EC @ 2 ml/L at 60 DAS if trap catches exceed 8 moths/day.
Spray Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.4 g/L or Neem oil (10,000 ppm).

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Rotate with Wheat or Pulses to disrupt bollworm cycle and reduce pesticide load.

climate_risk.unseasonal_rain_sensitivity: High at boll opening stage (discolors lint)

crops.advisory_tip: Monitor bollworm with pheromone traps; avoid late-stage pesticide overdose.

crops.name: Chana (Chickpea / Gram)

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 40 kg + Sulphur 10 kg per acre
Spray 02% Urea or 19:19:19 (10 g/L) + Boron (1 g/L)
Spray 00:52:34 (15 g/L) to prevent premature flower drop

pest_management.remedy: Set up 4 bird perches per acre; spray Emamectin Benzoate @ 4 g/10 L at early instar stage.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: N-fixing champion; adds fertility and requires almost zero irrigation in conservation tillage.
crops.advisory_tip: Requires zero or only 1-2 supplemental irrigations; restores soil nitrogen naturally.

crops.name: Bajra (Pearl Millet / Shree Anna)

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 25 kg + MOP 15 kg per acre
Urea 30 kg per acre after weeding

pest_management.remedy: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl @ 2 g/kg seed; ensure timely sowing before July 15.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Tolerates salinity and heat; ideal crop to restore abandoned or water-depleted acreage.
crops.advisory_tip: Ideal for arid zones; high market demand under National Millet Mission with rising MSP.

crops.name: Onion

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 45 kg + MOP 40 kg + Sulphur 15 kg (crucial for pungency and storage life)
Urea 35 kg per acre
Urea 35 kg + MOP 20 kg per acre
Spray 00:00:50 (Potassium Sulphate) @ 10 g/L; stop irrigation 15 days before harvest

pest_management.remedy: Install blue sticky traps (15/acre); spray Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5 ml/L or Spinosad @ 0.3 ml/L.
Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Tebuconazole @ 1 ml/L.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Deep bulb cultivation loosens soil structure; rotate with pulses or cereals to curb soil pathogens.
crops.advisory_tip: High profit volatility; invest in raised beds and solar-ventilated storage structures.

crops.name: Tomato

fertilizer_schedule.nutrients: DAP 60 kg + MOP 50 kg + Neem Cake 100 kg per acre
Fertigation with 19:19:19 (3 kg/acre/week) + Calcium Nitrate 2 kg/acre (prevents Blossom End Rot)
Fertigation with 00:00:50 (4 kg/acre/week) for firm texture and red color

pest_management.remedy: Pheromone lures; spray Cyantraniliprole 10.26% OD @ 1.8 ml/L.
Prophylactic spray of Copper Hydroxide (2 g/L) before rainy spell; Azoxystrobin (1 ml/L) for curatives.

crops.crop_rotation_benefit: Avoid planting after potato or chilli (solanaceous family); rotate with maize or cowpea.
crops.advisory_tip: Staking and drip fertigation increase yield by 40% and protect against wet soil rot.
